title: A Speculative Parallel DFA Membership Test for Multicore, SIMD and Cloud Computing Environments
relevance: Core theoretical foundation. Defines the convergence factor gamma and proves speedup bounds for speculative parallel DFA matching. Reports gamma < 0.47 for practical DFAs.

title: ANG: Accelerating NFA processing on GPUs via Exploring Multi-Level Fine-Grained Parallelism
relevance: Extends speculative parallelization to NFA processing on GPUs. Achieves 11.74x average speedup using input-chunk-level speculation. Validates that speculative automata parallelism works at scale.

title: Parallel Construction of Simultaneous Deterministic Finite Automata on Shared-Memory Multicores
relevance: Extends speculative DFA parallelism to simultaneous multi-DFA matching. Shows that convergence properties can be exploited for multiple automata in parallel.

title: A Compiler Framework for Fixed-Topology Non-Deterministic Finite Automata on SIMD Platforms
relevance: Compiler framework for NFA on SIMD platforms. Embeds automata topology in code and stores only transition symbols in memory, achieving memory-efficient SIMD automata processing.
